items.summary: Schwab Advisor Services' digital onboarding now lets firms add PDF forms to digital envelopes and countersign their own documents.
Syntax Direct personalized indexing is now available through iRebal without changing existing workflows.
Clients can eAuthorize wires and checks submitted via Import Transactions, with up to 2,000 transactions per upload.

Jotform's pricing page advertises a limited-time Black Friday discount on annual plans (not Enterprise); no dates or amounts are shown publicly. Listed prices are unchanged: Bronze $39, Silver $49, Gold $129 monthly.
Ester tax and estate planning is now available to all advisors in Schwab Advisor Center at no additional fee.
Claude Desktop now lets users choose a release channel: Stable (default, fewer updates) or Latest (a new version roughly daily).
Claude Meetings is rolling out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans; Claude joins Google Meet calls as a visible participant to take notes, answer questions and build artifacts.
Wealthbox now integrates with Osaic's eQuipt platform. Osaic-affiliated advisors can push or pull a client profile on demand, with a side-by-side view to choose which fields update.

The unified Chat and Cowork experience turns on by default for Enterprise organizations whose admins hadn't set it; it needs Chat and code execution enabled and excludes zero-data-retention, HIPAA-ready and customer-managed-key orgs.
Morningstar's 11-12-26 update fixes ETF and closed-end fund 3-year standard deviation showing an outdated month, removed watchlist items reappearing, and embedded video sizing.
Google Calendar now syncs guest additions with third-party calendars such as Outlook: the organizer is notified when a guest adds guests, and the event updates when such a notice arrives.
Gemini Notebook can now build a site from a chat prompt, opening it in a new tab; rollout started November 16 on web for users 18 and older.
Google Meet adds an optional setting that shows participants a clickable link to the presented Docs, Sheets or Slides file; it is off by default.
